title: Mount begin binds the current follower

verification.actor: MOUNTED species 56 (mankey), acquired through mount; live handle and attached presentation required
verification.trigger: Press Select to mount; Request one Hop with the rebound current follower
verification.observable: Each accepted motion has exactly one terminal result; No logical commit occurs after motion cancellation; Control returns after the selected motion finishes or cancels; No active actors share a nonzero target reservation; Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch; Every active actor has an attached presentation

setupMutations.change: Shared prepared native spawn of saved Igglybuff 174 party slot 3 as previous follower. No profile or timer writes. After record start, normal Y opens saved highlight 2 and Y confirms Mankey 56. Wait for that exact current follower to finish its selection movement and release its reservation before closed-selector Select mounts it.

limits: Prepared previous-follower setup cannot prove natural spawning. The three native Y/Y/Select edges occur after setup with normal timers and unchanged profiles.
One full same-subject Hop proves this mount/control witness, not rendered trajectory, general movement timing or a soak.

Public producer contract: Hop motionKind is 2 for START and COMMIT/FINISH. CONTROL_RETURNED valueA is mounted inputOwnership 1, not the Wild value 0. ACTOR_REBOUND reports roles 2 to 3; CONTROL_REBOUND reports input owners 0 to 1.
